description: Post-screening resolved horizontal vorticity-tendency diagnostic, fixed before its computation; not a closed three-dimensional budget.
terrain: Static original IFS surface pressure, two-cell erosion before differentiation products, smoothed valid coverage at least 0.95; identical across sources and times.
discretization: Spherical centered finite differences, products at native resolution before smoothing; six-hour endpoint tendency and trapezoidal right-hand-side average.
residual_interpretation: Contains unmeasured vertical advection, tilting, friction and other effects, analysis increments, temporal/spatial discretization, and forecast inconsistency. It is not an isolated heating or model-error term.
